subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected, conflicting macOS onboarding PR be closed as superseded by the merged current-main setup direction, or should the contributor rebase and narrow it to any still-needed UI details?
rationale: The repository policy prevents auto-closing protected maintainer-labeled items, and the remaining choice is maintainer product/ownership direction rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation and route any remaining macOS remote/setup UX questions to the newer canonical items.

options.title: Request a narrow rebase
options.body: Ask for a fresh branch on current main that removes superseded wizard/setup work and fixes the security/auth findings before review.

options.title: Keep as design context
options.body: Leave it open only as a reference while current macOS remote/setup direction is handled elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation and route any remaining macOS remote/setup UX questions to the newer canonical items.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged current-main macOS onboarding direction that most directly overlaps this branch.
